header.summary: Engineering leader with 13+ years of experience moving IT delivery from vendor-driven to platform-driven, with source code, CI/CD and delivery under the organisation's own control. Currently GitHub Delivery Lead at KBC, bringing the whole KBC BE IT landscape onto a single GitHub platform. Previously led 90 people across 9 teams at Nike, including vendor and nearshore delivery, and was CTO at TrendMiner.

nike.description: Delivery Manager for software and third-party vendor solutions at Nike EMEA, working with 3 vendors covering both staffing and nearshore teams, and responsible for integration and delivery across internal and external teams. Led 9 teams (90 people, 80+ engineers) delivering critical platform services for millions of customers across Europe. Created new teams oriented around the business, aligning business and IT, and presented business cases at board level. Ran internal and external workshops on Agile, DevOps and AI to scale delivery and improve lead times.
